**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] The user has a desktop computer that is around 5 years old.
- [PREFERENCE] The user is considering upgrading their desktop computer due to random freezing issues.
- [PREFERENCE] The user prefers a traditional desktop over an all-in-one desktop for future upgradability.
- [EVENT] The user recently upgraded their home Wi-Fi router to a new mesh network system 3 weeks ago.
- [CHANGE] The user believes their desktop computer might be due for an upgrade due to improved internet connection.
- [TEMPORAL] The session date is 2023/05/25 (Thu) 01:12.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant mentioned that random freezing can be frustrating and suggested several potential upgrades: CPU, RAM, Storage, Graphics Card, Motherboard and BIOS, Operating System, and Cooling System.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant advised running a virus scan and checking system event logs to identify the cause of freezing.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided a list of key components to consider for upgrading: CPU, RAM, Storage, Graphics Card, Operating System.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested budget ranges for different types of desktops: General Use ($500-$800), Gaming ($800-$1,500), Content Creation ($1,200-$2,500), Business/Professional ($800-$2,000).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended checking current computer specs, researching options, visiting a store, and reading reviews.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant highlighted the importance of Wi-Fi 6 support, Gigabit Ethernet, fast storage, multi-core processor, and sufficient RAM for taking full advantage of the new mesh network.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided pros and cons of All-in-One desktops versus traditional desktops.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant listed popular desktop brands: Dell, HP, Lenovo, Apple, Asus.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant confirmed that traditional desktops are easier to upgrade and repair compared to all-in-one desktops.
